eips.title: State Creation Gas Cost Increase
eips.summary: A bug fix for the state creation gas cost increase EIP was ratified for inclusion after client teams confirmed support.

moments.context: Maria Silva explained that Pavel found a bug in EIP-8037, the state growth EIP, and a fix was implemented by Geth and Erigon and tested on DevNet 8.
Maria confirmed all EL client teams supported or would not oppose the fix, and next steps are merging the spec change and deploying on DevNet 8.
Parithosh asked if there was anything else for the 8037 change; Maria confirmed nothing further from her side.

eips.title: Custom sweep threshold for validators
eips.summary: Greg from Lido gave a status update on the custom sweep threshold EIP proposed for Hegota, noting specs, a Prysm POC, and tests are ready.

moments.context: Parithosh noted an update from an account about EIP-8148 and EIP-8205 on the agenda.

Greg from Lido explained EIP-8148 allows custom sweep thresholds for 002 validators, and reported the EIP is updated, feature specs exist, a Prysm POC draft is available, and tests are ready pending CFI status.

eips.title: Withdrawal credentials preregistration
eips.summary: Greg from Lido provided a status update on the withdrawal credentials preregistration EIP proposed for Hegota, noting specs and a system contract PR are open.

moments.context: Parithosh mentioned updates about EIP-8148 and EIP-8205 on the agenda.

Greg explained EIP-8205 introduces withdrawal credential pre-registration, with an updated EIP, feature spec on Consensus specs, and a system contract PR already open, inviting client teams to review.
